brain-reindex.note: NAME IS HISTORICAL AND MISLEADING. It does NOT reindex `otchealth-brain`. It runs `semantic.mjs reindex`, which refreshes ONE index: memory-exec. It was named correctly when memory-exec WAS 'the brain' (company-brain/brain.mjs still labels it '(shared brain)'); it only became a trap once the separate, writer-less `otchealth-brain` index stole the noun. For ~12 days this job ran GREEN every 6h while otchealth-brain sat frozen, and its green was read as proof the brain was being tended. Writer-of-record for memory-exec: see setup/expected-indexes.json.
